The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `ryzen-7-8845hs` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 590 of 666 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 1.000 to 1.005 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). The background_activity records show a Defender security-intelligence update at 03:52Z during this session's native-fast-t1 run; no Defender scan ran in either session. Relates to #721 and #737.

! more than 150% of the DRAM roofline for a bandwidth-bound result: the entry's byte model is probably wrong.
